parameters.query: SELECT hn.id, hn.title, hn.raw_content, hn.linked_tickers_json, hn.ambiguous_candidates_json, hn.is_general_market, hn.has_full_text FROM trading.historical_news hn LEFT JOIN trading.historical_news_assessments hna ON hna.news_id = hn.id WHERE hna.id IS NULL AND (hn.ticker_match_status IN ('matched','ambiguous') OR hn.is_general_market = TRUE) ORDER BY hn.id LIMIT 45;
